sentence: Please put your homework in your schoolbag before you leave.
synonym: pack your homework in your bag
synonymNote: 意思相同，都表示把作业放进书包里

distractors.word: do your homework in your schoolbag
distractors.note: do表示完成作业，不是放入书包

distractors.word: leave your homework in your schoolbag
distractors.note: leave表示遗留，不是主动放入的动作

distractors.word: find your homework in your schoolbag
distractors.note: find表示寻找，不是放入书包的动作
